title: KODEX — KMIND: FOUNDATION
description:
KODEX — KMIND (FOUNDATION). whole-device foundation surrogate — one shared-trunk multi-task net across transport / equilibrium / state / disruption, trained jointly; reports shared-representation transfer honestly (incl. negative transfer)

Benchmark: **foundation model**: one shared trunk across 4 domains (66958 params); transfer vs matched single-task — pos none, neg ['equil', 'state'], neutral ['disrupt'] (transport data-starved) — honest multi-task result

Part of KODEX, the Kronos Family of Codes — a benchmarked AI/ML fusion surrogate suite with calibrated uncertainty and an abstention gate (predict(x) → (y, uncertainty, in_domain)). Provenance: references 10.5281/zenodo.21842371. Home: https://kronosfusionenergy.com/kodex/kmind · suite: https://github.com/KronosFE/kronos-ml. Licensed under Apache-2.0. Honest card preserved verbatim.
